presentation.label: TRACK-KEYED COMPRESSION
presentation.summary: Drive the stock COMPRESSOR detector from any audio track, with key filtering, gain and audition controls.
presentation.overview: The stock COMPRESSOR gains KEY, KFLT, KGN and MON beside RMS on its SETUP page. Choose T1-T8 as the detector input, filter and adjust the key, or audition it on the receiving track.
highlights: KEY selects OFF or any of T1-T8, including the other DSP core.
KFLT provides low-pass, bypass and high-pass key filtering.
KGN applies a smoothed, stepped detector gain; 64 is unity.
MON auditions the processed key on the receiving track.
Stock ATK, REL, THRS, RAT, GAIN, MIX and RMS remain available.
usage: Select COMPRESSOR in FUNC + FX1/FX2 SETUP with LEVEL and YES.
Hold FUNC and press the selected FX button to open SETUP; choose the key with encoder C.
Turn MON off before normal listening; KEY OFF restores self-keying.

access.location: Audio track FX1 or FX2: COMPRESSOR in FUNC + FX SETUP; main compression controls on page 1; RMS and KEY/KFLT/KGN/MON on page 2.
steps: Select the receiving audio track. Hold FUNC and press FX1 or FX2 to open its SETUP chooser.
Turn LEVEL to COMPRESSOR and press YES. The visible name stays COMPRESSOR; the module takes that stock row on FX1 and in the FX2 chooser.
Press the selected FX button for ATK, REL, THRS, RAT, GAIN and MIX. Hold FUNC and press that FX button for SETUP with RMS, KEY, KFLT, KGN and MON.
In SETUP use encoder C for KEY, D for KFLT, E for KGN and F for MON. The unnamed inherited descriptor slot is not a new sidechain control.
Set KEY to OFF and MON to OFF to restore self-keying; choose NONE to remove the effect.

controls.name: ATK
controls.doc: Stock attack control, raw 0-127; determines how quickly compression engages. Exact time mapping is inherited from stock.

controls.name: REL
controls.doc: Stock release control, raw 0-127; determines recovery after detector level falls.

controls.name: THRS
controls.doc: Stock threshold, raw 0-127; lower it until the selected key causes gain reduction.

controls.name: RAT
controls.doc: Stock compression ratio, raw 0-127; raise it to increase compression.

controls.name: GAIN
controls.doc: Stock output make-up gain, raw 0-127. This is distinct from KGN, which changes the detector input.

controls.name: MIX
controls.doc: Stock dry/wet balance, raw 0-127; 127 is fully processed and 0 is dry.

controls.name: RMS
controls.doc: Stock RMS detector control, raw 0-127; retained on page 2 without changing its implementation.

controls.name: KEY
controls.doc: OFF restores self-keyed stock detection; 1-8 selects absolute T1-T8, including tracks on the other DSP core.

controls.name: KFLT
controls.doc: 0-63 low-pass; 64 bypass; 65-127 high-pass. LCD shows LP/OFF/HP. One-pole filter uses a 32-entry 40-2200 Hz table and special near-bypass edges; no exact cutoff readout.

controls.name: KGN
controls.doc: Raw 0-127 about unity at 64. Sixteen 8-value buckets yield -24 to +21 dB in 3 dB steps; the gain is smoothed with a nominal 5 ms block-rate time constant. LCD displays the stock bipolar raw offset, not dB.

controls.name: MON
controls.doc: OFF is normal compression; ON plays the processed key on this receiving track instead of its output, after both effects. MON requires a selected KEY.

limitations: Replaces COMPRESSOR on FX1 and in the FX2 chooser with the same stock effect ID 0x18; the visible effect name remains COMPRESSOR.

With Keep stock FX2 effects on, SPRING REV gives up its code space for this module; reassign any old SPRING REV slots. With it off, every stock FX2 effect leaves the FX2 chooser and the stock FX1 effects stay.

It builds beside the other Modwerk modules unless native octabam and Modwerk both refuse the selection. Among the nine visible modules other than Analog BD it builds beside every other module and every pair; 786 of the 1,024 selections that contain it build. 0.1.2's larger ColdFire unit (sc_norm, +204 B) runs the effect-menu cave out of room in 12 selections that 0.1.1 built, each holding Euclid with Scale Quantizer or eight or more modules. The selection checker says which applies.
It cannot be combined with Analog BD, which currently runs with the original effects only, or with MIDI Scenes, which is standalone firmware.
Its core-private keybus and cross-core window overlap BusDelay and BusVerb, which Modwerk does not carry; the native resource ledger refuses them beside it.
MUTE_MODES is not imported here. The author reports that muted-key behavior with MUTE_MODES needs its matching integration variant.
Cross-core keys use a buffered shared window. Core rate-locking and real-time race behavior require hardware qualification; no exact hardware latency is claimed.
The fixed-key MON stash is indexed by the source track. Simultaneous compressors sharing one KEY with different key processing need explicit interaction testing.
Every download carries the core logger; the module's LCD pages are identical with and without it.
No current Modwerk hardware, audio or maximum-load result is claimed. Emulator captures show the UI only, from an MKII panel, and do not qualify audio, transport or MKI operation.

Cycle bounds are conditional software models of this module's own contribution, measured on the author-form image whose Sidechain bytes this build reproduces; they are not summed with other modules. Physical hardware and silicon wall-clock timing remain unverified.

storage.label: Declared DSP reservation
storage.conditions: Full reservation of the module's own contribution including inherited stock state/scratch and complete hardware DSP stack capacity; no new heap, SDRAM or delay buffer. Stock RTOS/UI frames remain inherited. Measured on Modwerk's native image of this source (MAIN OS 2816f0bc...); 0.1.2 adds 204 B of ColdFire code (sc_norm) and 24 B of caller stack, and rewrites 12 stock bytes at the two detour sites in place. See exact addresses in TESTING.md.

processing.label: Worst-case processing
processing.conditions: One instance plus shared tap/MON work, all branches with 2x instruction-model allowance; sixteen-slot core upper 69,496 includes stock reserve.

impact.conditions: Standalone sixteen-slot compressor configuration; bounds are conditional software estimates. No arbitrary whole-device utilization claim.

cpu.rationale: UI formatters (KEY peak 132 instructions) plus sc_norm, a per-frame check of the sixteen FX slots: 144 instructions/frame with no compressor, 752 worst when sixteen stale compressors reset in one frame; 171 measured in the OT DEMO project. Static frame bound 8,192 of a 9,577-cycle allowance.

dsp.rationale: Bounded key tap, gain/filter detector and monitor stages. Sixteen-slot core bound 69,496 modeled cycles/block including reserved stock work.

memory.rationale: 23,520 bytes at sixteen instances including inherited stock buffers; no new heap/SDRAM delay storage.

conditions.parameterExtremes: Every KEY 0..8, KFLT 0..127, sixteen KGN table buckets, MON/RMS switches and stock parameter endpoints; static all-branch analysis.
conditions.parameterModulation: Block-wise simultaneous parameter changes model published LFO/scene/p-lock/CC values; no new control-source callback or unbounded DSP loop.
conditions.modeSwitching: Every split 0..15, both stock init and split COMPRESSOR calls; OFF/ON KEY, HP re-entry and MON toggle. Firmware Part reload scheduling belongs to reserved stock work.
conditions.maxLoad: Sixteen COMPRESSOR FX slots, eight per core. Standard stock dispatcher/transport reserve; the bound is this module's contribution and is not summed with other modules. Arbitrary other stock FX/USB or RTOS stalls are not a measured streaming deadline.
conditions.inputConditions: Silence and impulse matrix; author numeric stage suite; signal-independent all-branch bound includes every fixed loop. No physical audible or cross-core timing claim.

conditions.parameterExtremes: sc_norm: every FX slot holding COMPRESSOR (id 0x18) with KEY 0..8 (left alone) and KEY 9..255 (reset), in the Part working store and the live lane; KEY 0..8 and KFLT 0..127 formatter calls through the real stock sprintf.
conditions.parameterModulation: LFO, p-lock, scene and CC changes write the same page-2 bytes the stock editor writes; sc_norm reads them once per frame and never calls the kernel or UI. A KEY inside 0..8 is never rewritten, so modulation inside the control range costs only the compare path.
conditions.modeSwitching: Part change, Part reload, project load and transport start bring stored page-2 bytes into the working store or the lane; each copy is judged only against its own FX id. The worst frame is sixteen stale compressors reset at once (both copies of all eight tracks' FX1 and FX2), priced cold.
conditions.maxLoad: Sixteen COMPRESSOR slots (FX1 and FX2 on eight tracks), both detour sites (0x4000cae8 every frame; 0x40003d1c has no static caller and never ran in a 600-frame coverage run, priced as if it also ran every frame). Budget: 10% of a 362.8 us frame at 264 MHz (9,577 of 95,779 cycles), Modwerk's ColdFire allowance; the other 90% is reserved for stock frame work. UI formatters run in the UI task at the 30 Hz redraw, outside the frame path (TESTING.md).
conditions.inputConditions: Signal-independent: sc_norm reads only FX ids and page-2 bytes. Stock-saved compressors (slots 8..11 = 0x7f/0/0/0), in-range keys and arbitrary byte values were exercised in the emulator; the bound covers every branch.

hardware.summary: On an Octatrack MKI the author flashed Modwerk's native image of this source (the module alone, stock FX2 kept) and reported all checks passing: a COMPRESSOR saved before the module was installed came up with KEY OFF, KFLT and KGN centred and MON OFF; two instances on T1 FX1 and T5 FX2, keyed from each other across the DSP cores, both ducked and stayed independent; MON auditioned the key; Part save/reload, project save/reload and a power cycle kept both compressors' settings.
limitations: A functional report: duration, project, material and tempo were not reported.
Two instances, not the sixteen-slot maximum the cycle and memory models price; no overload was reported, none was measured.
No measured chip timing, memory canary, recording, recovery or stress test; cross-core key latency and rate locking were not measured.
The flashed image is the module alone; the Modwerk download (with the core logger) and selections with other modules were not flashed.

tutorial.title: Quick tutorial: duck T5 from a T1 kick
steps: Back up the project, work on a disposable copy, and put a kick on T1 and a sustained sample or loop on T5. Build with Modwerk; with Keep stock FX2 effects on, SPRING REV gives up its code space, so reassign any track that used it.
Select T5, hold FUNC and press FX1, turn LEVEL to COMPRESSOR and press YES. Press FX1 for the main page; hold FUNC and press FX1 to return to SETUP with the key controls.

Set KEY to T1, KFLT to 64, KGN to 64 and MON to OFF. On the main page, keep MIX at 127, raise RAT and lower THRS until the T5 signal dips when the T1 kick plays; adjust ATK and REL for the desired envelope.
Briefly set MON to ON on page 2 to hear the processed T1 key on T5, then return MON to OFF. Try KFLT below 64 to focus on bass, or above 64 to remove bass from the detector.
Return KEY to OFF and MON to OFF to restore self-keyed stock compression. Set MIX to 0 for the dry signal or select NONE to remove this effect; stop transport before saving the disposable project.
